body: Chief on P1-3 candidate c3c8f8c: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — two small fixes, then it lands. Independent run (archive, clean pin): align 96/96, laws 67/67, fixtures 87/87, embed-grakern 20/20. Review probes confirmed membership-before-min (cost.scala:376-386 via the same ContradictionDetector ModeGate uses; a role-reversed chart present in the input with a flattering 0.0 provider distance is excluded and the blended total is unchanged), Neutral deleted, NaN → Missing(Undefined(NotFinite)), receipts canonical and permutation-identical, ADR D4b matches. REQUIRED: (1) the permutation law is vacuous — StructuralReductionSuite.scala:133 Gen.pick(view.nodes.size, view.nodes) returns the original order when n == size (0 of 200 samples permuted); use a seeded Random.shuffle over the nodes; (2) seal constructors — private[align] on CostBreakdown (cost.scala:197) and on StructuralMemberEstimate/StructuralExclusion/StructuralReductionReceipt/StructuralReduction (:152-189); nothing outside align constructs them, so it is free and it makes m1's 'constructible only inside align' premise true (it was not, before this candidate). RECORDED as deliberate: CostBreakdown.coverage is renamed to sourceChartCoverage with no deprecated alias (no external consumer; my precision (2) is superseded). Nit, doc only: when the unit has no chart the receipt is unit-side-abstained (members empty, observedEstimateCoverage 0/0) — say so in the Scaladoc. Post the revised SHA + align 3-platform evidence; I land it on main (you may commit it yourself if your tooling allows — narrow, unstaged until then).
